key_terms.كَانُوا: used to be / used to say (imperfective past habit)

ai.seo_question: What did the hypocrites used to say according to this verse?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah As-Saff, this verse underscores the dissonance between the hypocrites' (Munafiqun) outward declarations of unity and their inward dissent, a key theme in Shia exegesis regarding the preservation of true faith amidst political and social stratification. It serves as a narrative pivot to detail their specific behaviors, highlighting how their words often masked their true intentions during the early Muslim community's formative struggles.
